query:
UPDATE calendar_events
        SET status = $2,
            starts_at = $3,
            ends_at = $4,
            start_date = $5,
            end_date = $6,
            time_zone = $7,
            recurrence_lines = $8,
            organizer_email = $9,
            organizer_name = $10,
            conference_url = $11,
            conference_provider = $12,
            schedule_updated_at = $13,
            updated_at = GREATEST(calendar_events.updated_at, $13)
        WHERE id = $1
